name: Primer React
summary: GitHub’s MIT Primer design-system React components with interactive product docs demos.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of many Primer React components — not the full Primer stack (CSS, Rails, etc.).
Requires ThemeProvider + BaseStyles; historically styled-components peer (verify current peer deps for installed version).
Product docs URLs use kebab component paths (e.g. text-input, action-menu).
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Primer action button with variants and sizes.

demo.peerNotes: MIT @primer/react (GitHub Primer). Docs pages host live demos + copyable examples. Wrap with ThemeProvider + BaseStyles.

copyPrompt.text: Use Primer React free MIT component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://primer.style/product/components/button. Install with `npm install @primer/react`. Import from `@primer/react` and wrap the app with `ThemeProvider` + `BaseStyles`. Home: https://primer.style/. Docs: https://primer.style/product/getting-started/react/. Repo: https://github.com/primer/react. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/primer/react/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2018 GitHub, Inc.). Pricing free.
